# OMNIVOX

> UK/EU cloud contact centre: Twilio voice (preview, progressive, power + AMD, inbound ACD/IVR), a Work Inbox for SMS, WhatsApp, email, live chat and social DMs, and custom wallboards. £25 a seat. Prepaid voice minutes. Digital is not in the voice wallet.

OMNIVOX is operated by Quanterae Solutions. Platform fee £25 per agent per month (sales policy). Voice credits: approximately 5p outbound / 4p inbound per connected minute, one-minute minimum. SMS / WhatsApp / email are not deducted from Call Credits. Sign-in: https://omnivox.vercel.app/login (IP-whitelisted; /WL).

## Product facts

- Live dial methods: manual / click-to-call, preview, progressive (1:1), power (ratio > 1, AMD-gated)
- Twilio AMD is live. Adaptive Power and statistical predictive are waitlist only — predictive is not shipped
- Eight-channel catalog is live in code. Org-ready requires DID / WABA / mailbox / widget / social tokens
- Work Inbox is live. One OmniConversation per channel. No unified timeline. No tickets
- WhatsApp: Twilio WABA, Meta 24h window, HX Content SID or SMS fallback. No broadcasts / HSM catalog
- Custom wallboards: builder, TV mode, playlists, ~40 widgets including DIGITAL_WAITING
- Inbound: platform-managed UK numbers, queues, hours, visual IVR. No BYOC
- Conference transfer / whisper / barge off by default
- Prepaid voice wallet covers inbound and outbound only
- UK GDPR: the customer is the data controller; OMNIVOX is the data processor
- A Data Processing Agreement is provided at onboarding
- Not a conversational-AI platform. AI Voice Agent is a bounded inbound Pilot
- Contact: hello@omnivox.co.uk
- App login: https://omnivox.vercel.app/login
